name: BannerMOTDplus
notes: Found the official BannerMOTDPlus 2.0.0 JAR staged on Home Server; its SHA-512 matches the official Modrinth asset. Its plugin.yml lacks folia-supported: true, which Folia requires. A second staged cyoria-only-774 JAR is a modified copy with unknown provenance; both remain outside plugins. Modrinth marks the project ARR, and no source suitable for a Folia port was found on accessible Tailscale targets. Do not patch or publish a derivative without maintainer permission.
